description: Link preview and SEO metadata for a URL: HTTP status, final URL, response time, title, meta description, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, canonical, language, favicon, RSS feeds, JSON-LD types and robots directives. $0.001 USDC on Base via x402. Price: $0.001. First call returns the x402 PaymentRequired (no charge); retry with payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

x402_payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload, for clients that cannot set params._meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to get the exact price.
